5289-5913-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5289-5913-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-4247-7166.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4247-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1429-3967-4981.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

765-5231-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

215-3291-3499.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-3499.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-3249-5173-5921.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

3967-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
3967-7096--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

240-1251-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

4446-5170-5686-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-5170-5686-6132.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

575-2511-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-2511-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 6.

2173-2921-5010-5708.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

109-1357-4697.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
109-1357-4697.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
109-1357-4697.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

280-1479-6754.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3499-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3499-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-3499-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1356-1651-3195-4574-6694.description:
Activate Dromar's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dromar's Attendant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Oracle's Vault's second ability by tapping it, exiling Dromar's Attendant from the top of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn without playing its mana cost.
Cast Dromar's Attendant from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and creating a Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Dromar's Attendant, untapping Oracle's Vault.
Repeat.

5412-5720-5721-6664.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5412-5720-5721-6664.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

224-277-2157-5954.notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
224-277-2157-5954.description:
Cast Overlord of the Hauntwoods by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the Everywhere token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-4659-5994.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-4659-5994.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
3490-4659-5994.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servos.

974-1268-2157.easyPrerequisites: Crab Umbra attached to Romana II.
974-1268-2157.notablePrerequisites:
Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-1268-2157.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Romana II.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-3490-4535.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
1636-3490-4535.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Intruder Alarm and Good-Fortune Unicorn trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Good-Fortune Unicorn trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature that entered the battlefield.
Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

437-509-2750-3094-4131.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-2750-3094-4131.description:
Activate Memnarch's first ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Sphinx's Disciple to become an artifact.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-5370-5434.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Master of the Veil, adding {C}{C}.
When Master of the Veil dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Master of the Veil from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Master of the Veil triggers, turning itself face down.
Repeat.

311-413-4424.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
311-413-4424.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Coral Trickster.
When Coral Trickster dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Coral Trickster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
When Coral Trickster enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Coral Trickster's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Coral Trickster triggers, untapping target permanent.
Repeat.

803-2034-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-2034-4302.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Repeat.
